verdict.rationale: Windmill documents first-party self-hosting via Docker Compose or a Helm chart on Kubernetes, so users can keep their data on infrastructure in a location they choose. The evidence never addresses region selection or data-residency guarantees for the hosted cloud offering. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-host Windmill on your own infrastructure
For larger and production use-cases, use our Helm chart to deploy on Kubernetes.
